title: Cotton Whitefly (Bemisia tabaci) Management Advisory
content:
Crop: Cotton (Gossypium hirsutum)
Disease/Pest: Whitefly (Bemisia tabaci)
Region: Punjab & North Cotton Zone
Authoritative Source: Punjab Agricultural University (PAU) / ICAR-Central Institute for Cotton Research (CICR)
Official Bulletin: https://cicr.icar.gov.in
Retrieval Date: 2026-09-17
Match Level: Verified Exact Crop & Disease Match

1. Surveillance & Economic Threshold Level (ETL):
• Regularly monitor whitefly populations on 3 leaves per plant (upper, middle, lower).
• Economic Threshold Level (ETL): 6-8 adults per leaf or 20 nymphs per leaf.
• Install yellow sticky traps @ 20 traps/acre for mass trapping and monitoring.

2. Management & Chemical Treatment (CIBRC / PAU Approved):
• Below ETL: Spray neem formulation (Azadirachtin 0.03% EC / 300 ppm @ 1.0 L/acre).
• Above ETL: Spray CIBRC-registered insecticides such as Pyriproxyfen 10% EC @ 500 mL/acre or Diafenthiuron 50% WP @ 200 g/acre or Afidopyropen 50 g/L DC @ 400 mL/acre.
• Avoid tank-mixing pyrethroids which induce whitefly resurgence.
• PHI & Safety: Pre-Harvest Interval is 21-30 days.
cultural_precautions: ETL monitoring; yellow sticky traps; avoid excessive nitrogen.
sanitation_guidance: Eradicate alternative weed hosts (e.g. Kanghi buti, Peeli buti).
moisture_irrigation_guidance: Avoid water stress during square formation.
non_chemical_management: Yellow sticky traps; neem based formulations.
chemical_treatment: Pyriproxyfen 10% EC @ 500 mL/acre or Diafenthiuron 50% WP @ 200 g/acre at ETL.
cibrc_registration_details: Pyriproxyfen 10% EC and Diafenthiuron 50% WP CIBRC approved for cotton whitefly.
content_hi:
कपास सफेद मक्खी प्रबंधन (PAU / ICAR-CICR):
नियमित निगरानी करें। आर्थिक क्षति स्तर (ETL: 6-8 वयस्क/पत्ती) पहुंचने पर ही पाइरीप्रॉक्सीफेन 10% ईसी @ 500 मिली/एकड़ या डायाफेन्थियुरॉन 50% डब्ल्यूपी @ 200 ग्राम/एकड़ का छिड़काव करें। PHI: 21-30 दिन।

title: Cotton Leaf Curl Virus (CLCuV) Advisory
content:
Crop: Cotton (Gossypium hirsutum)
Disease: Cotton Leaf Curl Virus (CLCuV)
Region: Punjab & North Cotton Zone
Authoritative Source: PAU Ludhiana / ICAR-CICR
Official Bulletin: https://cicr.icar.gov.in
Retrieval Date: 2026-09-17
Match Level: Verified Exact Crop & Disease Match

1. Symptoms & Management:
• Thickening of smaller veins, upward/downward leaf curling, and enation (leaf-like outgrowths) on underside of leaves.
• Transmitted exclusively by whitefly (Bemisia tabaci).
• Non-chemical: Cultivate PAU-recommended CLCuV-tolerant hybrids; eradicate alternative weed hosts like Abutilon indicum.
• Vector Management: Keep whitefly population strictly below ETL.
sanitation_guidance: Destroy infected stumps; clear field bunds.
chemical_treatment: Manage whitefly vector with CIBRC registered insecticides; no direct viricide exists.
content_hi:
कपास पत्ती मरोड़ विषाणु (CLCuV):
सहनशील किस्में अपनाएं और सफेद मक्खी का नियंत्रण समय पर करें। विषाणु के लिए सीधे कोई दवा नहीं होती।
